description: Internet availability and fiber context for a US address or area. Give one geography shape: a street address (for example '520 South Main Street, Goshen, Indiana 46526'), lat+lng, FCC location_id, 5-digit ZIP, city+state (for example Warsaw, IN), state, or a city alone for disambiguation candidates. Address answers are one FCC location; city/state/ZIP answers are explicitly area-level and never a guarantee at a door. Every answer states precision, grain, source, as_of, and a canonical live page.

address.description: US street address, e.g. '520 South Main Street, Goshen, Indiana 46526'

city.description: US city, e.g. 'Warsaw'. Pass state when known; city alone returns candidates.

lat.description: Latitude (use with lng as an alternative to address)

location_id.description: FCC location id from a previous check (skips address resolution)

state.description: Two-letter USPS code or full state name, e.g. 'IN' or 'Indiana'

name: check_availability
title: Check internet availability
